records.title: LMMs Meet Object-Centric Vision: Understanding, Segmentation, Editing and Generation
records.reason: This is a survey of object-centric vision capabilities in large multimodal models; the abstract covers understanding, segmentation, editing, and generation without a concrete inference-efficiency contribution.

records.title: Scientific Graphics Program Synthesis via Dual Self-Consistency Reinforcement Learning
records.reason: The work improves scientific-graphics program synthesis using dual self-consistency reinforcement learning; the primary abstract concerns task success/training, not inference efficiency.

records.title: LLM-Based Listwise Reranking Under the Effect of Positional Bias
records.reason: The paper addresses positional bias in LLM listwise reranking through training/fine-tuning and reports ranking quality. It does not provide a runtime, token, memory, or serving-efficiency intervention.

records.title: Knowledge-guided multimodal LLM with mixture-of-experts for interpretable defect detection and fault diagnosis: An industrial AI copilot
records.reason: Primary DOI/publisher record could not be retrieved at https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jmsy.2026.02.017 (server returned Internal Error), and the packet contains no abstract. Industrial multimodal-LLM application cannot be assessed for inference-efficiency relevance without primary text.

records.title: KAT-Coder-V2 Technical Report
records.reason: KAT-Coder-V2 is a large agentic coding model/training-system report. The reported 6.2x speedup is for tree training; inference is used for rollout generation, but the paper does not establish a new deployed LLM inference-efficiency method.
